explication: Strix is an autonomous AI penetration-testing platform. A user launches a local or cloud scan against an application; the interface configures the run, the core orchestrates agents and isolated sandbox sessions, agents investigate and validate exploits through security tools, and reporting produces findings, coverage, remediation-oriented artifacts, and a viewer experience. Sampled files strongly support sandbox lifecycle, MCP dispatch, TUI IPC, report coverage, and viewer polling; several README capabilities remain represented at their enclosing directories because their implementation was not sampled.
